verdict.rationale: Mistral's pricing page says you can self-host its models, gives per-model license labels (e.g. Mistral Small 4 under Apache 2.0) and points to a 'Model weights' page with download links and usage guidelines. Model cards mark releases such as Mistral Large 3 as open-weight, and community users report running Mistral models locally (Devstral) and self-hosting them. Missing for 10: a clear license statement (Apache 2.0 is described as research/individual-only while commercial use needs a separate Mistral license), explicit disclosure of which models are closed-weight, and hands-on evidence of the download-and-run workflow.
